---
description: Show the OCP Devcenter SDLC entry points and review command.
agent: ask
---

Output everything below this line exactly as written. Do not add a preamble, commentary, or closing text.

# What do you want to do?

## Plan something

- **`/ocp-plan`** (no arguments) - Start or continue planning a Devcenter task.

## Build something

- **`/ocp-build`** (no arguments) - Continue from an existing spec, ticket, or implementation branch.

## Ship something

- **`/ocp-ship`** (no arguments) - Review, commit, open the Azure DevOps PR, and finish the spec workflow.

## Something else

- **`/ocp-review-uncommitted`** (no arguments) - Review local changes before committing.
- **`/ocp-review-pr XXXX`** - Review an Azure DevOps pull request.
